preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
For each test case, m and k must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: sum(a) == m and all(0 <= a_i <= m for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: The sum of the array a must equal m, and each element a_i must be between 0 and m.

postconditions.description: The size of the beautiful matrix n must be at least 2.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b[i][j] <= k for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: All elements in the matrix b must be between 0 and k.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(b[i][j] for j in range(n)) == m for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The sum of each row in the matrix b must equal m.
